text: Handling deadlines well requires good time management. Start by prioritizing your tasks: decide which ones are most important or urgent, and work on those first. It is also wise to manage the scope of your work. If a project is too big, break it into smaller steps, or agree to do less. Communication matters too. If you think you may miss a deadline, tell your teacher, boss, or team early. They can often help or adjust the plan. Remember, planning ahead and speaking up are much better than waiting until the last minute.
